author: Ari Koslow
title: Theo Gillen promoted to Double-A
desc: The Rays promoted Theo Gillen to Double-A Montgomery.
impact: Gillen was hitting .342 with 12 home runs in High-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Zazueta promoted to Double-A
desc: The Dodgers promoted Christian Zazueta to Double-A Tulsa.
impact: Zazueta was part of the Caleb Ferguson trade with the Yankees. He'll look to continue to work his way up the Dodgers system.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tucker Musgrove promoted to Double-A
desc: The Padres have promoted RHP Tucker Musgrove to Double-A.
impact: Musgrove is the 7th-ranked prospect in the Padres system. He leads the minor leagues in K/9 at 19.4.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Adkins signs minor league deal with Dodgers
desc: The Dodgers signed Chase Adkins to a minor league contract.
impact: Adkins was previously in the Angels organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan VanWey expected to be called up Monday
desc: Logan VanWey is expected to join the Astros bullpen in Toronto.
impact: VanWey had been optioned at the beginning of June. There should be an official roster move announced before first pitch.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Bieber to now start Tuesday
desc: Shane Bieber will start on Tuesday against the Astros.
impact: Bieber was originally slated to start Monday's series opener. With Sunday's game postponed, Dylan Cease will now start on Monday followed by Bieber on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dylan Cease to now start Monday
desc: Dylan Cease will start for the Blue Jays on Monday against the Astros.
impact: Cease was scheduled to start Sunday's game against the Cubs that was postponed. The Blue Jays pushed everyone back one day in the starting rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Triston Casas (abdomen) working his way through hitting progression
desc: Triston Casas is making his way through the early stages of a hitting progression.
impact: Casas has been hitting off a tee and soft toss. He is recovering from an abdominal injury he suffered on a setback during his rehab from a ruptured patellar tendon. He could progress to facing live pitching soon.

author: Nate Miller
title: Trea Turner crosses home plate twice in Sunday's win
desc: Trea Turner went 1-for-3 with a single, a walk, and two runs scored in Sunday's 6-2 win over the Mets.
impact: Turner has picked things up over the past several days. The veteran shortstop has picked up six hits over his last 13 at-bats and scored seven runs over the Phillies' last four games. Turner has added a steal and an RBI in that span.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kyle Schwarber drives another one out of the yard Sunday
desc: Kyle Schwarber went 1-for-3 with a three-run homer, a walk, and two runs scored in Sunday's 6-2 win over the Mets.
impact: Apparently Schwarber was not satisfied with his three homers on Saturday, so he went ahead and added another to his league-leading total Sunday night. The veteran slugger has been on an absolute assault over the past couple weeks, putting up a ridiculous 1.313 OPS with six homers, 12 RBI, and 11 runs scored in his last 10 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Harper follows up cycle with three more hits
desc: Bryce Harper went 3-for-4 with a solo homer and a double in Sunday's 6-2 win over the Mets.
impact: Harper hit for the cycle on Saturday, and he came up just a triple short of doing so again Sunday night. The Mets are certainly glad to be rid of the two-time MVP, as he's gone 7-for-9 with four RBI the last two days.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: David Peterson struggles in loss to Phillies
desc: David Peterson took the loss Sunday night against the Phillies after allowing four runs over four innings. He struck out five and walked four. Peterson issued back-to-back walks to begin the game and later allowed a three-run homer to Kyle Schwarber in the second inning.
impact: Peterson now owns a 6.09 ERA and did not strengthen his case for additional starts, though the Mets are currently thin on alternatives.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Carson Benge homers Sunday against Phillies
desc: Carson Benge went 1-for-3 with a solo home run, a walk, and two runs scored Sunday against the Phillies. He took Zack Wheeler deep to the opposite field in the third inning.
impact: Benge has seen time out of the leadoff spot after a rough April, and his lineup placement is worth monitoring with Francisco Lindor nearing a return from the injured list due to a calf injury.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Jakob Junis records fifth save
desc: Jakob Junis earned his fifth save Sunday against the Padres with a scoreless ninth inning. Jacob Latz was unavailable after pitching Friday and Saturday. Junis opened the inning by allowing singles to Fernando Tatis Jr. and Xander Bogaerts but retired Ty France, Sung-Mun Song, and Rodolfo Durán to preserve the one-run lead.
impact: Junis now has five saves on the season and owns a 1.97 ERA across 32 innings.

author: Bruno Mulé
title: Nathan Eovaldi strikes out nine in win over Padres
desc: Nathan Eovaldi earned the win Sunday against the Padres, allowing three runs on seven hits over six innings. He struck out a season-high nine batters. Eovaldi had his start pushed back by one day due to knee soreness and allowed all three runs in the fourth inning.
impact: Eovaldi improved to 7-7 on the season and has recorded just one no-decision. He is tied for 17th in the majors in wins and sixth in losses, with his next start set to come against the Blue Jays.
